records.observed: Three read-only foreach projections failed before inventory.
records.recovery: Materialize foreach output before ConvertTo-Json.

records.observed: The first concurrent repository probe produced no usable output.
records.recovery: Use literal-path scalar Git probes.

records.observed: Two required v10 reference reads returned blank despite nonempty files.
records.recovery: Verify bytes and use IO.File ReadAllText with explicit UTF-8.

records.observed: A second metadata foreach pipeline repeated the parser fault.
records.recovery: Use an explicit materialized rows array.

records.observed: A wrapper rejected an embedded PowerShell newline before baton reading.
records.recovery: Join lines with Environment.NewLine.

records.observed: A broad worktree scan returned no usable result after roughly thirty seconds.
records.recovery: Narrow discovery to exact owner directories.

records.observed: No separate Ilyra v695-v7 final overview was located.
records.recovery: Retain the unavailable-source gap and do not invent content.

records.observed: The cited X post returned an internal read error.
records.recovery: Retain it as an unread named source.

records.observed: The first builder patch wrapper parsed a Markdown backtick as JavaScript.
records.recovery: Serialize builder source from a function body and patch without shell redirection.

records.observed: The first serialized builder body had one missing closing parenthesis and did not reach apply_patch.
records.recovery: Recover the exact attempted source from the current task log and correct only the syntax defect.

records.observed: Node 24 rejected direct --check of a TXT entrypoint because .txt is not a recognized module extension.
records.recovery: Compile TXT source through the CommonJS function or Module compiler used by the runners.

records.observed: The final source-recovery chunk requested one character beyond its exact bound and returned an error instead of source bytes.
records.recovery: Replace the tail from a stable marker using a dynamically bounded substring.

records.observed: The first owner-scope cleanliness projection did not match Git's collapsed untracked phase-directory row and returned false.
records.recovery: Treat the exact collapsed phase root as in-scope and require every other porcelain row to be absent.

records.observed: The first x1 invocation stopped before file creation because the assembled wrapper helper had a leading unary plus and no outer binding.
records.recovery: Remove only the two accidental leading plus characters, verify CommonJS bindings, and run a separately identified x1 recovery invocation.

records.observed: The first local preview tab creation timed out and reset the browser-control kernel; its outcome was unknown.
records.recovery: Discard the stale handle, refresh the browser inventory once, and bind only a returned tab.

records.observed: The first returned-tab binding used an undeclared variable and raised a local wrapper error.
records.recovery: Create a fresh declared reviewTab binding from the exact returned browser and tab.

records.observed: The first read-only DOM audit called getContext on a sandbox canvas proxy that did not expose it.
records.recovery: Inspect canvas attributes and rendered accessibility state without invoking getContext.

records.observed: The first audit recovery tried to reuse a binding that had not been created after the failed evaluation.
records.recovery: Use fresh declared audit and log bindings for the bounded recovery read.

records.observed: The x2 manifest rebind call returned no usable wrapper output at its twenty-second boundary.
records.recovery: Inspect the exact manifest bytes and verify both new receipt bindings before any retry; the file proved complete, so no retry was run.

records.observed: Three branches of a parallel read-only x2 validation batch returned blank projections while the installation branch completed.
records.recovery: Rerun only the missing read-only checks sequentially with bounded scopes.

records.observed: The first 312-card topology check returned no usable result at the default ten-second boundary.
records.recovery: Run the same read-only card check once with a thirty-second yield; it completed without replaying domain work.

records.observed: The first bulk x2 git add produced no usable output at thirty seconds and left zero staged entries.
records.recovery: Stage disjoint x2 metadata and bounded card ranges separately, then inspect the exact combined index.

records.observed: The first post-x2 equality wrapper returned no usable projection at about twenty-one seconds.
records.recovery: Repeat only the scalar Git equality checks with a full bounded yield; do not recommit or repush x2.

records.observed: The first worktree preflight found the baton terminal marker before its auto-added appendix rather than at EOF.
records.recovery: Move only the terminal marker to true EOF, retain the failed preflight, and run a separately named dependency-corrected preflight.
